newsitem.title: USA: Brooks Fiber Q1 network, utilization rises.
newsitem.headline: Brooks Fiber Q1 network, utilization rises.

text.p: Brooks Fiber Properties Inc said Monday the utilization of its networks and the number of buildings connected rose significantly for the first quarter.
Brooks said the number of buildings connected rose 468 percent to 2,810 as of March 31, versus 495 buildings last year.

Voice grade equivalent circuits increased to 668,494 compared with 165,122 circuits at the end of the quarter last year. The company said the circuits and number of buildings connected both reflect utilization.
The company had operational networks covering 1,253 miles as of March 31, a 147 percent increase compared with 507 miles in service as of March 31 last year.
Brooks reported a first quarter loss of $0.77 a share on revenues of $20.55 million, compared with a loss of $0.34 a share on $6.80 million in 1996.
